job.title: Staff Security Engineer
job.pay_full: $204,000 – $306,000 a year salary range; base salary is supplemented by equity compensation

details.about: Duolingo's mission is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available, for half a billion learners and growing. As Staff Security Engineer you'll shape and deliver Duolingo's security strategy, protecting learners, employees, systems and services, and work across Engineering, Product, Legal, Finance and IT to make practical risk decisions and help teams ship safely at scale. The role is based in New York City.
duties: Set technical direction for security across Duolingo's applications, cloud infrastructure and engineering systems
Lead complex, multi-team security initiatives from problem definition through implementation and ongoing ownership
Design and build scalable security services, controls and automation
Threat model systems, review architecture and code, prioritize risks and deliver mitigations with engineering teams
Strengthen the software lifecycle: secrets management, dependency security, vulnerability management and CI/CD controls
Measure security posture and define measurable outcomes for security programs
Lead technical response to significant security incidents and turn lessons into lasting improvements
Establish secure-by-default patterns for cloud and application infrastructure, including infrastructure as code
Explain risks and trade-offs to engineers and company leaders; mentor engineers
needs: A track record of leading large, complex, multi-team security engineering initiatives from proposal to production
Deep experience in at least two of: application security, product security, cloud security, infrastructure security, detection and response, or security automation
Strong software engineering skills in one or more languages and experience building reliable production systems or internal platforms
Experience securing cloud environments: identity, networking, data protection, secrets, logging and workload security
Threat modeling, architecture review, code review and vulnerability analysis on real systems
Infrastructure as code and CI/CD for repeatable, secure configurations
Sound judgment balancing security risk, engineering effort and business priorities; clear communication
Ability to work from or relocate to New York City
nice: Building a security program or capability from an early stage and scaling it
Securing large multi-account or multi-cloud environments, particularly AWS and GCP
Security platforms or paved-road patterns adopted broadly by engineers
Applying AI-assisted tooling to security analysis, remediation or control validation
details.benefits: Salary range $204,000 – $306,000 a year; the offer depends on work experience, skills and internal peer comparisons, and the posted range may change. Base salary is supplemented by equity compensation. Duolingo's benefits are described on its careers site, and your recruiter can share more on compensation.
notes: Candidates who meet some or most of the qualifications are encouraged to apply
Duolingo never asks for your Social Security number, bank details or passport, or for money, during interviews; real recruiters use @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com emails
